name: member-rewards-update-tool
description: Automates the process of updating used and expired Member Rewards. Also prepares a file to update Klaviyo
summary: Keeps member discount data up-to-date by processing recent usage and expired rewards from Shopify exports. Marketing and customer service teams rely on it to ensure customers' reward statuses are accurate and synced with Klaviyo profiles, removing manual work and errors. It also prepares and uploads updated customer files to Shopify and Klaviyo automatically, saving time and keeping rewards consistent.
